slots.jd.parcel-delivery.about:
Position summary
Fairlane Parcel Delivery seeks a Delivery Driver to transport and deliver parcels to customers in Columbus, Ohio. The Delivery Driver inspects the assigned vehicle, secures each load, follows dispatch instructions and completes deliveries on schedule. At minimum, candidates must hold a Driver Safety Certificate, have prior delivery driving experience and know defensive driving and load documentation. A Commercial Driver Licence is preferred.
slots.jd.parcel-delivery.duties:
Responsibilities
- Conduct pre-trip vehicle inspections and report any defects before departure.
- Secure each load and check its contents against shipping documents.
- Deliver parcels to customers on time and in good condition.
- Follow assigned routes and coordinate schedule changes with dispatch.
- Obtain customer confirmation at each stop and record delivery status.
- Maintain accurate driver logs and complete required paperwork at the end of each shift.
slots.jd.parcel-delivery.needs:
Minimum and preferred qualifications
- 1 or more years of experience as a delivery or commercial driver.
- Working knowledge of dispatch software, bills of lading and customer signoff procedures.
- Demonstrated defensive driving practice and competence in trailer coupling.
- Training in hazmat handling and safe load securement.
- Required: a current Driver Safety Certificate.
- Preferred: a Commercial Driver Licence.
slots.r1.b1: Performs pre-trip vehicle inspections and maintains accurate cargo documentation for each load, reducing departure delays by 20 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Plans daily delivery routes and checks bills of lading against each load before leaving the yard.
slots.r1.b3: Coordinates with dispatch on route changes and applies defensive driving on every run, reducing late deliveries by 20 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Keeps complete driver logs and updates delivery status in dispatch software throughout each shift.
slots.r1.i1: Delivery Driver at Stonebridge Logistics who delivers loads to customers on time and confirms each completed stop with dispatch.
slots.r1.i2: Delivery Driver at Stonebridge Logistics who inspects the vehicle before each run and reports any defects to the supervisor promptly.
slots.summary.1: Entry-level truck driving and dispatch professional with about 1 year of experience handling a share of daily deliveries under close supervision. Skilled in defensive driving, hours-of-service logging and delivery scheduling, and holds a Driver Safety Certificate.
slots.summary.2: Truck driving and dispatch professional at entry level with about 1 year of experience supporting delivery operations alongside a supervisor. Applies defensive driving, hours-of-service logging and delivery scheduling, backed by a commercial driving certificate from Lakeshore Trucking School.
